meta.title: Field Access — Visa Requirements
meta.grain: one row per DX destination x sending passport
meta.passports_chosen: United States, United Kingdom, Brazil, South Korea, Nigeria, India, Philippines, South Africa — a deliberate subset of widely-held sending passports, not the full 199x199 matrix (39,601 rows of mostly irrelevance).
meta.HARD_SCOPE_LIMIT: TOURIST/VISITOR entry policy ONLY. NOT permission to do religious work, NOT residency, and NOT a safety assessment. A country can be visa-free AND a place where this work carries real risk — orthogonal facts, and only the first is here.
meta.laws_not_done: Religious-freedom / assembly LAW per country is NOT in this corpus. No free keyless machine-readable source was found; USCIRF, Open Doors and Freedom House publish reports that need a cited human pass.
